messages:
Samir Patel: :rotating_light: Alert from kvcache-alerts — sustained cache growth on gateway-prod-7, continuous-batching throughput spike, streaming token cadence stalls reported by telemetry. High error budget risk.
Oncall Bot: Incident created • incident #INC-2023-1487 • severity P1 • initial detection 2301234567 • channels: #incidents, #eng-runtime, #eng-sre.
Tara Liao: seeing kv cache size jump from 40GB -> 220GB in ~8m on node set a. paging ops skyrocketed. paging queue length x3.
Ryan Chen: logs show repeated batches hitting an unexpected codepath after the recent batching-config rollout at 2301234200. suspect batch window shrink -> frequent partial KV writes.
Jin Park: confirmed streaming workers reporting token cadence stalls — they stall for 500-800ms during prefix fetches, then flush many tokens at once (partial flush).
Samir Patel: customer impact check — Lina, any CS reports from top tier customers?
Customer Success - Lina: @Samir one enterprise customer (AcmeRetail) reported degraded chat latency and timeouts on long-context prompts starting ~8:31pm. They're on Dedicated.
Tara Liao: stack traces from worker-009: 
```
E [kvcache] eviction surge: concurrent_prefetches=64, queue_len=423
W [batching] partial_flush_count=1543, avg_flush_ms=12
E [streaming] cadence_stall: last_token_ts_delta=0.8s
```
Samir Patel: initial mitigation ideas — 1) revert batching-config change to previous stable (rollout id 2023-09-14-3) 2) throttle continuous batching concurrency 3) temporarily increase KV eviction aggressiveness. Which is fastest to push?
Ryan Chen: revert is safest but takes ~5-10m to promote, might result in immediate drop in new regressions. Throttle can be done by toggling feature flag 'cbatch_concurrency' to 8 (currently 64) — quick toggle via ops.
ops-shift: I can toggle feature flag now in prod Canary. Will coordinate with Jin for validation.
Jin Park: do it. Also prepping a small hotfix patch to prevent partial flush logic from batching tiny prefixes — I can PR but deploy time longer.
SRE Bot: Note: paging pressure correlated with sustained prefetch amplification. See metric dashboards: kvcache.prefetch_rate, kvcache.paging_io_ops, streaming.token_cadence_variance.
Tara Liao: rolling the flag down on prod-7 now. ops-shift please run `rb config set feature.cbatch_concurrency=8 --env=prod` then watch paging queue.
ops-shift: running command now: `rb config set feature.cbatch_concurrency=8 --env=prod --scope=region-us-east-1`
ops-shift: ack — flag toggled.
Samir Patel: watching metrics. paging queue length dropping on prod-7 from 420 -> 110 in last 90s. kvcache growth slowed. :eyes:
Customer Success - Lina: AcmeRetail latency reports show partial improvement, they're asking for ETA on full rollback.
Ryan Chen: starting controlled rollback of batching-config rollout (id 2023-09-14-3) in us-east-1 canary -> 2 clusters -> all. Est 12m for full rollback.
Jin Park: while rollback is in progress, I'm enabling a temporary guard in runtime to drop micro-batches below 32 tokens to avoid partial flush. Quick patch applied via feature flag 'cbatch_min_size' = 32.
ops-shift: feature flag set. verifying logs... partial_flush_count dropping.
Tara Liao: streaming cadence stalls dropping to 60% of prior rate. token emit smoothing visible.
SRE Bot: Auto-alert suppression enabled for duplicates.
Samir Patel: customer comms — Lina, can you tell AcmeRetail we have mitigations live (throttle + min-size guard) and rollback in progress? ETA ~12m, will follow up.
Customer Success - Lina: yes, messaging sent. They asked about risk of data loss — clarified no user data lost, only latency and reordering. They want follow-up postmortem.
Ryan Chen: rollback completed across us-east-1 at 2301234810. monitoring global rollouts next.
Jin Park: hotfix PR merged to main for a permanent fix to partial flush logic — will schedule canary tomorrow.
Tara Liao: paging IO dropped back to baseline, KV cache sizes stabilizing across affected nodes.
Samir Patel: handoff to night oncall @ops-shift and @Jin — please continue to watch kvcache.prefetch_rate and streaming.token_cadence. If any regression, escalate to eng-runtime.
ops-shift: taking handoff. pinned playbook: /runbooks/kvcache-paging.md.
SRE Bot: Incident #INC-2023-1487 transitioned to status: mitigated • postmortem required. Tags: kv-cache, continuous-batching, streaming-cadence, customer-impact.
Samir Patel: quick RCA notes in thread: root cause — batching-config change reduced min batch size and increased concurrency causing prefetch amplification and micro partial-flush path triggering in streaming runtime; triggered paging pressure -> eviction surge -> cache blowup. Fixes: rollback, throttle concurrency, add min-size guard, follow-up hotfix.
Customer Success - Lina: AcmeRetail confirmed recovery and will monitor; they requested postmortem and timeline.
Jin Park: leaving a TODO: add a regression-eval for batch config combos in CI to catch perf cliffs.
Samir Patel: thanks all. closing incident channel updates — handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
